description: Get details about a specific workspace by its slug, including columns of its primary table surface, member count, and row count. A workspace contains one or more surfaces of any kind, in any combination. Use `list_surfaces` to enumerate every surface, then that surface's own tools (`list_rows`, `get_doc`, `get_html`, ...) to read or write it.

slug.description: The workspace slug, e.g. 'reddit-tracker'. Accepts either the bare slug or the org-prefixed form ('my-org/reddit-tracker') as shown in the dashboard URL.

name: get_workspace
